HSTU · Strategic Information

About the Research Data Repository

The Research Data Repository was conceptualized in 2023 by the Strategic Information Component to systematically collect and collate published and unpublished studies and reports.

The repository supports access to HIV, STI and TB research from Jamaica and the wider Caribbean and also brings toget

ighting HIV, STI and TB evidence, emerging trends and priority areas.

15 research areasplus Capacity Building, National and Special Reports, and Data Audit and Utilization.
Manuals · technical guidance · professional development

Capacity Building

Manuals, user-focused learning materials and professional development resources for HIV, STI and TB programme staff. Recent materials are prioritized, with the full collection available below.

Currentness checked against MOHW, HSTU and available national HIV/STI/TB programme reference files · September 2026
